annotation.reasoning_summary: The dataset represents building blocks or housing complexes (real-world objects) owned by housing associations. Topology hints show low shared boundaries and low coverage ratios, confirming these are discrete features rather than a full-area partition (tessellation). Numeric attributes are properties of these housing objects.
